topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution and outlines the session's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages during clonal cancer evolution.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and cell of origin in cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the role of tissue hierarchy, the cancer stem cell model, and cell of origin in tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependency in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate how inflammatory signals, environmental promoters, and stromal interactions drive malignancy and provide therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It details the sequencing, spatial profiling, and computational techniques used to map tumor heterogeneity and cell interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of multifactorial influences on cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how mutational, cell-of-origin, epigenetic, and microenvironmental factors coevolve to create permissive conditions for malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
